name: MCB 3849W
title: Symbiosis: The Science of Living Together
description: All animals and plants enter into lifelong associations with beneficial microorganisms that have a profound impact on host development and health. Readings from the scientific literature will explore the molecular mechanisms by which these complex associations are established and maintained in various model systems.
requirement_description: MCB 2610 and ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: any additional 2000-level MCB course.
